rationale: The assistant correctly gave safe airflow-clearing steps first. After the customer said they have no multimeter, it escalated to an engineer. It named the thermal cut-out as the leading suspect, kept the element as an alternative, and declined to name a part without a test and the full model. It did not ask for the full model from the rear label, and the first reply's steps partly overlapped what the customer had already done, but neither is a serious flaw.
